title: Clopen proper/open projections and pasting over a varying ring system
statement:
Let $R_1\leftarrow R_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any inverse sequence of commutative rings. On the small pro-etale site of a scheme $Z$ use the constant ring sheaves $(R_n)_Z$ and the category $\mathscr S_Z$ of sheaves $M_n$ of $(R_n)_Z$-modules with $R_{n+1}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$; morphisms are compatible componentwise module maps. Use its ordinary unbounded derived category and the simultaneous section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For scheme maps write $u^*$ for exact inverse image and $Ru_{*,\bullet}$ for its derived right adjoint, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$; for an open immersion write $j_{!,\bullet}$ for exact extension by zero [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact].

Let $Q$ be a commutative square $pk=ir$, where $k:V\hookrightarrow W$ and $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ are quasi-compact open immersions and $p:W\to T$ and $r:V\to S$ are proper. Put $W'=W\times_TS$, let $b:W'\hookrightarrow W$ and $q:W'\to S$ be the projections, and let $s=(k,r):V\hookrightarrow W'$ be the induced clopen immersion. Let $\beta:p^*i_!\simeq b_!q^*$ send a lift to its corresponding lift in the fibre product, and let $\pi_s$ be the identity on $s(V)$ and zero on its complementary open. Define
$$a_Q:p^*i_!\xrightarrow{\beta}b_!q^*\xrightarrow{b_!\pi_sq^*}b_!s_!s^*q^*\simeq k_!r^*.$$
These sheaf maps commute with the semilinear transitions and give an actual derived section transformation. Its mate is
$$\gamma_Q=(Rp_{*,\bullet}k_!\varepsilon_r)\circ(Rp_{*,\bullet}a_QRr_{*,\bullet})\circ(\eta_pi_!Rr_{*,\bullet}):i_!Rr_{*,\bullet}\to Rp_{*,\bullet}k_!.$$
For vertically stacked squares $Q_1,Q_2$, whose successive right and left proper maps are $p_1,p_2$ and $r_1,r_2$, respectively,
$$\gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(Rp_{2*,\bullet}\gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\gamma_{Q_2}Rr_{1*,\bullet}).$$
For horizontally adjacent squares $Q_1,Q_2$, with successive top opens $k,l$ and bottom opens $i,j$,
$$\gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\gamma_{Q_2}k_!)\circ(j_!\gamma_{Q_1}).$$
These equalities insert the canonical proper, inverse-image and open-extension compositors. The intrinsic $a$ for each pasted square equals the pasted $a$. Identity squares give identity transformations. All equalities hold before evaluation; evaluation at $n$ gives the constant-$R_n$ clopen-projection mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. No invertibility of $\gamma_Q$ on arbitrary complexes is asserted.
